verdict.rationale: Kong's AI Gateway/MCP docs mostly describe Kong governing, securing, and auto-generating MCP servers (Kong as MCP provider/gateway), which is the opposite direction of this story; the only direct evidence of Kong-family tooling consuming external MCP servers as a client is a single line in Insomnia's docs noting 'MCP Servers and Clients, which connect to external AI-ready tools and resources.' There's no detail on setup, tool invocation, or independent confirmation of this client behavior. Missing for 10: concrete Kong-side MCP client configuration/workflow docs, examples of using a connected MCP server's tools, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
